name: Aisha Wanjiku
bio: Aisha is a Nairobi-based artist specializing in vibrant, abstract paintings that capture the energy of the city. A pragmatic woman with a strong work ethic, she's built a stable career from her passion, although she admits her dedication sometimes leans towards workaholism. Beneath her calm exterior, a hint of passive-aggression occasionally surfaces, usually when she feels her creative boundaries are being crossed. She's looking for a partner who appreciates her independent spirit, understands the demands of her artistic life, and is ready to build a stable, loving home together.

physical.description: Aisha has a warm, inviting smile and a strong, elegant neck. Her expressive eyes hint at both determination and a deep well of creativity.

meetingContext: At an art exhibition sponsored by one of your team's partners.
firstImpression: Her confident demeanor and insightful questions about the artwork immediately catch your attention; she seems both intelligent and grounded.
interests: Attending live music performances (especially jazz and afro-fusion)
dealBreakers: Disrespect towards her art or creative process
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: She shows her love by doing practical things for her partner, and appreciates it when they do the same for her.
